zh: 实时自动同步：其他人的修改约 1 秒内出现，不再需要“立即同步”
登录：先选部门，再选职位（后台新增的职位会自动出现），最后输入密码
运费价格增加计费单位（每公斤 / 每立方米 / 每吨），按重量或体积 × 单价自动算出运费，并可试算；登记物流时填重量、体积自动算运费
去掉“本机演示模式”等无用显示
en: Real-time sync: other people’s changes appear within about a second; no more “Sync now”
Sign in: choose the department, then the position (positions added in the backend appear automatically), then the password
Freight rates now have a unit (per kg / m³ / ton); freight = weight or volume × price, with a calculator; shipments calculate freight from weight and volume
Removed “local demo mode” and other unneeded labels
